content:
A listener writes “I’m from Spruce Pine, right next to the Blue Ridge Parkway. My first experience, I guess, happened when I worked at a Chinese restaurant. It was a really strange place on the county line.

There was gambling there, and likely prostitution and moonshine activity back in the 1920s and 1930s. I’ve heard that the original building burned down and was later rebuilt as a restaurant that literally looked like a Chinese pagoda.

Anyway, when I was about 16, I was working upstairs when I looked up and saw an old woman wearing 1920s-style lingerie and nothing else. She didn’t say anything. At the time, I was just embarrassed and thought I had accidentally startled a woman while she was getting dressed. But logically, there shouldn’t have been anyone upstairs, and based on the layout of the building, there really couldn’t have been. Also, she had black eyes.

Being only 16, though, I was more worried that I had done something wrong than about what I had actually seen. When I told the other people who worked there, they all freaked out. I’ll attach a video of the place. It’s super creepy.

My second experience happened when I was working as a newspaper reporter in the same town. I photographed a huge crop circle in Green Mountain, North Carolina. I believe there’s a photo of it online, and it’s likely the one I took. It was enormous and incredibly symmetrical, located literally in the middle of nowhere. But when I arrived, there were so many people who had driven from all over the country just to see it. This was in the early 2000s, before the internet was as widespread as it is today, which makes the whole thing even stranger.

The Brown Mountain Lights are only a few miles from where I grew up. My dad saw them while he was on fire patrol with my grandfather, who was a park ranger. He said it was like watching a fireworks show. Later, although I’m not sure how much later, they found a calf missing one of its legs in a pasture they had near there.

This area is also extremely close to Crabtree Falls, which was featured in a recent episode when a man went off the trail and saw a creature near the waterfall. I can personally attest to how creepy that place is.”
